privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: The Olympic Online Exam System (the "System") is operated by Hanoi University of Mining and Geology. We understand your personal information is important, so this page clearly explains what we collect, how we use it, and how we protect it. By using the system, you agree to the terms below.
privacy.s1Intro: When you log in and use the system, we collect essential information, specifically:
privacy.s1Item1: Basic personal information: Full name, student ID, email address, department or class. We do not collect sensitive information such as health status, financial data, or biometrics.
privacy.s1Item2: Academic data: Exam history, results, scores, rankings, and forum posts.
privacy.s1Item3: Technical data: IP address, device type, browser, and login logs — this information helps us ensure fair exams and detect cheating promptly.
privacy.s2Intro: Collected information is used solely for the following purposes:
privacy.s2Item1: Verify identity to ensure the correct user is logged in.
privacy.s2Item2: Organize exams, grade submissions, store results, and display leaderboards.
privacy.s2Item3: Send exam schedule notifications, reminders, and important system updates.
privacy.s2Item4: Anonymized statistics to improve platform quality — no individual is identified in this process.
privacy.s2AuthItem1: You log in using your university-issued email — this is the only way the system identifies you.
privacy.s2AuthItem2: We do not require photos of identity documents or any biometric data.
privacy.s3Intro: We are committed to never selling or exchanging your personal information. Information is only shared externally in these cases:
privacy.s3Item1: When required in writing by authorized government agencies under applicable law.
privacy.s3Item2: For internal auditing and inspection by the University.
privacy.s3Item3: When you explicitly consent in writing or confirm on the system.
privacy.s4Item1: Data encryption: Your password is one-way encrypted — even administrators cannot view it. All data transmitted between your device and our servers is encrypted to safety standards.
privacy.s4Item2: Retention period: Academic results are stored long-term for your reference at any time. If you wish to delete personal data, please contact us via the email below.
privacy.s4Item3: Your responsibility: Keep your password confidential and do not share your account. If your account is compromised due to personal negligence, we may not be able to assist with recovery.
privacy.s5Content: The system uses a small session file on your browser to maintain login status — so you don't have to log in again each time. This file is purely technical and is not used for tracking behavior or advertising.
privacy.footer: This policy may be updated as needed to comply with legal requirements or significant system changes. Each update will be announced on the system.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: Welcome to the Olympic Online Exam System of Hanoi University of Mining and Geology (the "University"). By registering or logging in, you agree to the following terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the system.
terms.s1Item1: Who can use it: The system is for students, lecturers, and staff of the University. You log in using your University-issued email (@humg.edu.vn) — this is the only way to verify you belong to the University during exams.
terms.s1Item2: Accurate information required: You must log in with your correct name and student ID. Any form of identity fraud to take exams on behalf of others is strictly prohibited.
terms.s1Item3: Keep your password safe: Your password is yours — protect it. All actions on your account are considered performed by you — if your account is compromised due to personal negligence, we may not be able to help.
terms.s1Item4: No account sharing: Absolutely do not lend or borrow another person's account to take exams in any form.
terms.s2Intro: To maintain a fair examination environment, you must not:
terms.s2Item1: Attack, illegally access, or intentionally exploit system vulnerabilities in any form.
terms.s2Item2: Use multiple devices simultaneously for one exam, unless permitted by a proctor.
terms.s2Item3: Use software, extensions for automated text composition, or answer lookup during exams.
terms.s2Item4: Copy, screenshot, or distribute exam content without authorization from the organizers.
terms.s2Item5: Handling violations: The system logs all access activity. If cheating is detected, the Exam Board may void your exam results without prior notice.
terms.s3Item1: University property: All question banks, exams, system interfaces, and technical documentation are copyrighted by Hanoi University of Mining and Geology. Recording, copying, or redistributing exam content violates regulations and will be strictly handled.
terms.s3Item2: Your content: Your exam submissions, posts, and forum content remain yours. However, by posting on the system, you grant the University permission to store, grade, analyze, and display results for educational purposes.
terms.s4Intro: The forum is a space for academic exchange. When participating, please note:
terms.s4Item1: Only discuss topics related to academics, expertise, or exam regulations.
terms.s4Item2: Do not post content that violates laws, offends others, or goes against social norms.
terms.s4Item3: Administrators may remove posts or lock accounts that violate rules without prior notice.
terms.s5Item1: The system is provided as-is for internal educational purposes. We strive for stable operations but cannot absolutely guarantee zero technical issues.
terms.s5Item2: Your-side issues: If you lose internet connection, encounter browser errors due to software, or have device problems during an exam — unfortunately, we cannot organize a retake for individual cases.
terms.s5Item3: For scheduled maintenance, we will try to notify in advance and avoid conflicts with official exam schedules.
terms.footer: These terms may be updated when the system is upgraded or when required by law. Continued use of the system after changes means you accept the latest version.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: A brief introduction to the Olympic platform and the people behind this project.
about.whatContent: Olympic is an online practice and exam system built specifically for students and lecturers at Hanoi University of Mining and Geology. The platform helps you familiarize yourself with exam formats, study systematically, and track your learning progress — all completely free and with unlimited attempts.
about.whyContent1: It started from a real need: students needed a place to practice before Olympic exams, but materials were scattered, old exams were hard to find, and there was no way to know where you stood compared to others.
about.whyContent2: We wanted to solve that with a centralized system — where you can find exams, take them, view results, and discuss with peers all on one platform.
about.commitItem1: Quality content: Question banks are curated and reviewed, closely following real curriculum.
about.commitItem2: Completely free: No fees whatsoever — whether creating an account, taking exams, or viewing results.
about.commitItem3: Listening to users: The system is regularly updated based on feedback from students and lecturers. If you find something that could be better, let us know.
about.commitItem4: Data security: Your personal data and learning history are strictly protected and never shared with third parties.
about.member1Desc: Lecturer at the Faculty of Basic Sciences — Hanoi University of Mining and Geology. She provides academic guidance and has been with the team since the early days of the project.
about.member2Desc: Primarily responsible for technical work: from UI design and system programming to deployment and operations.
about.member3Desc: Supports question bank editing, brainstorms new features, and contributes to improving platform content.
about.footer: If you have suggestions, find bugs, or want to contribute to the question bank, don't hesitate to contact us. Every piece of feedback helps make the platform a little better.
